name: Manjares Bakery
tagline:
Pan dulce,
baked fresh
every morning.
about: A Latin bakery on Blenheim Boulevard in Fairfax City. Customers drive across Northern Virginia for its conchas, semitas de piña, pan de muerto, and tres leches cakes.
locationNote: Open early · Call ahead for cake orders

themeCopy.story:
Baked with love.

themeCopy.label: Conchas, semitas & tres leches

reviews.author: Ivan R.
reviews.text: The Tres Leches was moist, perfectly balanced, and beautifully done. Even our foodie friends couldn’t stop talking about it

reviews.author: Jennifer H.
reviews.text: The semita de pina is delicious. The bread is soft and the filling has small pieces of pineapple. One of the best I've had in NOVA area.

reviews.author: Mon S.
reviews.text: Fresh baked greatness, authentic mexican concha flavor 😍😍😍 Drove 30 minutes, and was so worth it.
